scene: The booth prints glowing transit passes, unlocking a bustling multi-level transport concourse.
picture: Side-scrolling view of the open concourse. On the left, a yellow moving walkway rolls toward an arcade sign. The silver-haired boy in his mint-green hoodie, headphones, and dance bag stands left of centre holding shiny passes. In the centre sits a docked river hover ferry. On the far right waits an open glass lift.
shown: a flat glowing yellow walkway rolling toward the left arcade entrance
a sleek hover ferry docked at the centre water gate with ramps down
a tall glass lift with disco lights waiting open on the far right
